scenarios.name: Restore an unlocked view after hiding its solid

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user copies Primary as BrowserView and activates the copied view
The MCAD Software has a part containing one visible solid body
an unlocked copied view is active
the solid body is visible in the Primary view
the user chooses All Hidden from the copied view context menu
the solid body is hidden in the viewport
the user activates the Primary view
the user activates the copied view again
the solid body is hidden in the viewport
